SD02-015.name: Friendly Power
SD02-015.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, give one of your Spirits +1000 BP for each of your Spirits in the same family as the targeted Spirit.

SD02-002.name: Misaal
SD02-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Blocks)
Exhaust every Spirit with the same cost as the opposing attacking Spirit.

SD02-017.name: Strong Draw
SD02-017.effect:
[Main]
Draw three cards, then discard two cards from your Hand.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

SD02-005.name: The Angelia Cherubim
SD02-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
For each Yellow Symbol on your Field, reveal a card from your decktop. Add a Magic card among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Every opposing Spirit that is blocking your Spirits with [Brilliance] is treated as LV1.

[LV3] [Brilliance] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, return all Magic cards you used during this battle to the Hand.

SD02-003.name: The Angelia Dunamis
SD02-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Blocks)
When this Spirit blocks an opposing Cost 2 or less Spirit, when the current battle ends, end the Attack Step.

[LV2][LV3] [Brilliance] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, return all Magic cards you used during this battle to the Hand.

SD02-006.name: The Assassin Weaseve
SD02-006.effect:
[LV2] (When Destroyed)
You can deploy a Nexus card from your Trash, without paying the cost.

SD02-009.name: The BeastCommander Kuyultha
SD02-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit becomes the target of [Tribute], by returning this Spirit to the Hand, treat as having sent the cores on this Spirit to the designated area.

[LV2]
Give this Spirit and every Spirit with [Tribute] you control the effect: "(When Battles) This Spirit gains +2000 BP."

SD02-021.name: The BeastMachine Sai-Drill
SD02-021.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit becomes the target of [Tribute], return an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit without [Tribute] to the decktop.

SD02-011.name: The BeastPrince Bahamunt
SD02-011.effect:
[Tribute: Cost 3 or more → Trash]
After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from a Spirit you control with a designated or higher cost to the targeted area.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Look at the entire opposing Hand, and discard a Magic card among them.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
The opponent can't use Magic effects of the same color as the Magic cards in their Trash.

SD02-018.name: The BraveColonel Dragron
SD02-018.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit becomes the target of [Tribute], destroy two opposing 4000 BP or less Spirits without [Tribute].

SD02-019.name: The DarkKnight Schwart
SD02-019.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit becomes the target of [Tribute], send two cores from any opposing Spirits without [Tribute] to their Trash.

SD02-007.name: The DogPoliceman Bernald
SD02-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block opposing Cost 3 or less Spirits while exhausted.

SD02-013.name: The Generate Altar
SD02-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When the opponent would summon a Cost 3 or less Spirit card without [Tribute], they must pay one extra cost.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
When summoning a Spirit card with [Tribute], the cost of all your Spirits with the same family as that Spirit card increases by +3.

SD02-012.name: The Heaven's Door
SD02-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life would be reduced by the attack of an opposing LV1 Spirit without [Tribute], discard a card from your decktop. If that card is a Spirit card, your Life won't be reduced. Also, if it has [Tribute], add it to the Hand.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
The attack of your Spirit with [Tribute] can't be blocked by opposing Spirits with a level equal or inferior to that Spirit's.

SD02-014.name: The Magic Control Tower
SD02-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your Nexuses are destroyed, by sending a core from your Field/Reserve to your Trash, one of the destroyed Nexuses returns to the Field, in the same condition.

[LV2]
When the opponents uses a Magic effect, you can negate that effect. Then, return this Nexus to the deckbottom.

SD02-001.name: The MysteriousBeast Pooxan
SD02-001.effect:
[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is also treated as a Blue Spirit.

SD02-020.name: The RainbowWings Jewelg
SD02-020.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit becomes the target of [Tribute], put two cores from the Void to your Reserve.

SD02-008.name: The RhinoMousquetair Grhinos
SD02-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 1 or less Spirit.

[LV2] [Assault: 1] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

SD02-010.name: The RoaringSwordmaster Lowen
SD02-010.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy opposing Cost 0/1/2/3/4 Spirits, one of each.

[LV2][LV3] [Assault: 1] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your Spirits with [Assault] gain +3000 BP.

SD02-004.name: The SacredBeast Haktak
SD02-004.effect:
[Tribute: Cost 3 or more → Trash]
After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from one of your Cost 3 or more Spirits to the Trash.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Choose either the "Imaginary Beast" or the "Beast Head" family. For each Spirit you control in that family, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit is blocked by an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit, refresh one of your Spirits with [Tribute].

SD02-016.name: Wing Boots
SD02-016.effect:
[Flash]
Target a Spirit you control. During this turn, when battle resolves, if that Spirit's level is equal to or higher than the blocking opposing Spirit's, without comparing BP, treat the attack as not having been blocked.
